candidates.snippet: -566: Birth of Siddhartha Gautama - Siddhartha Gautama, the founder of Buddhism, was born. -528: Attainment of Enlightenment - Siddhartha Gautama attained enlightenment under the Bodhi tree, becoming the Buddha. -525: First Sermon - The Buddha delivered his first sermon at the Deer Park in Sarnath, setting the Dharma wheel in motion. -483: Death of Gautama Buddha - Gautama Buddha passed away at the age of 80, achieving Parinirvana.
